additional_info.subject: Request for Assistance with Charging Issues on SICHARGE D
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am reaching out regarding recurring issues with charging sessions on the SICHARGE D charger for Transports DUBOC, serial number: MPR6170002075. These difficulties have been ongoing for several weeks, and more specifically for the past three weeks. Earlier today, at 1:55 PM, a driver reported another failed charging session:
Details of the observed incident:
•
Connector: 1 (CCS plug)
•
Session duration: 00:00:21
•
Date and times:
•
Start: 12/17/2024, 1:22:00 PM
•
End: 12/17/2024, 1:22:21 PM
•
Energy transferred: 0.4 kWh
After several attempts to start a charging session, I performed a full restart of the charger. Following this operation, the first connection worked properly.
We kindly request a complete log extraction for the period from 1:20 PM to 2:05 PM on December 17, 2024, to help identify the root cause of the issue.
Your prompt response to this matter would be greatly appreciated, given its impact on their transport operations.
Thank you in advance for your assistance.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
